hemisphere: Every experiment is mirrored so its injection lies in the right hemisphere. Right is therefore ipsilateral to the injection and left is contralateral.
layout: uint16 count[voxels], uint16 mean[voxels] scaled by 65535
source: Allen Mouse Brain Connectivity Atlas projection_density grids at 100 um, injection voxels masked per experiment, injections mirrored onto the right. Oh et al. (2014), Nature 508:207-214.
